title: nf-core/bamtofastq references datasheet schema
description: Schema for the references datasheet provided with --references. Each property maps a datasheet key to a pipeline parameter; other datasheet keys are ignored.

genome.errorMessage: Genome name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fasta.errorMessage: Fasta must end in '.fa', '.fasta', or '.fna' (optionally .gz) and cannot contain spaces

fasta_fai.errorMessage: Fasta index must end in '.fa.fai', '.fasta.fai', or '.fna.fai' (optionally .gz) and cannot contain spaces
